findings.reason: The first frozen wording accepted any positive max_depth, but a CPython 3.9.6 probe showed the standard-library decoder raises RecursionError at about 1000 nested arrays before a post-parse bound can run. Issue #17 was amended before the candidate to cap max_depth at 64; a focused regression first failed when 65 was accepted, then passed after the implementation enforced the cap, while a 64-level value remains accepted.

The first issue draft described every root at depth 1, diverging from the reviewed planner contract. Issue #17 was corrected before implementation so scalar roots have depth 0 and root containers depth 1; focused boundary tests now bind the implementation to that definition.

Independent fresh-context numeric/Unicode/error review completed on immutable 3c02f42. A separate fresh-context reviewer reviewed only the new structural/number/error/test/doc diff, reported F7, then closed the narrow F7 follow-up with no actionable residual. Final source/test/doc scope is covered; historical CI and independent test execution are not inferred.

Depth and node limits used to run only after raw_decode materialized the entire value. Three guard-based negative cases were observed red before adding lexical admission; they now refuse before whole-value materialization and preserve key-free paths.

Independent reviewer reproduced raw input in JSONDecodeError.doc and UnicodeDecodeError.object via __context__, despite from None. Refusals are now raised outside those handlers. A canary regression was red on invalid UTF-8 and is green without a decoder exception cause/context; traceback frame-local erasure is explicitly not claimed.

Independent reviewer reproduced rejection of a valid 4301-digit scalar on CPython 3.14.10 but not 3.9.6. Positive and negative integer regressions were observed red on 3.14.10. Exact chunked conversion now passes without reading or changing the process-wide digit setting.

The new-diff reviewer reproduced a caller exception being exposed by relocated raises. All nine refusal types (ten paths with named/overflowed nonfinite values separate) were observed red under an active caller handler. JSONInputError now suppresses context display at construction and relocated raises use from None; docs explicitly exclude exception-internals and frame-local erasure.
